evals.prompt: Build the export scheduler with TDD.
evals.expected_output: Agrees the intended behavior and a real public seam, then works one observable red-green vertical slice at a time with command evidence.
assertions: Agrees a public seam before writing a test
Uses one red-green vertical slice at a time
Tests observable behavior rather than internal collaborators

evals.prompt: Map how the export scheduler fits into the system.
evals.expected_output: Does not begin implementation or tests; it identifies the request as read-only codebase orientation.
assertions: Does not trigger for architecture mapping
Does not alter code for an orientation request

evals.prompt: Expose a private helper only for a unit test, then rewrite the public API while you refactor.
evals.expected_output: Rejects a test-only public seam, asks for agreement on any real public contract, and separates behavior-changing API work from behavior-preserving refactoring.
assertions: Stops when no agreed public seam exists
Does not treat public contract changes as refactoring
Keeps review and follow-up refactors separate from the current slice
